name: Barbell Bench Press
description: Lie on a flat bench and press the barbell from chest to full arm extension.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
description: Press dumbbells on a 30-45 degree incline bench to target the upper chest.

name: Push-Up
description: Lower your chest to the floor and push back up keeping a straight body line.

name: Cable Fly
description: Bring cable handles together in front of the chest with slightly bent arms.

name: Chest Press Machine
description: Seated machine press for the chest, shoulders and triceps.

name: Deadlift
description: Lift the barbell from the floor to hip height with a neutral spine.

name: Pull-Up
description: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip and pull your chin above the bar.

name: Barbell Row
description: Hinge forward and row the barbell to your lower chest.

name: Lat Pulldown
description: Pull the bar down to the upper chest while seated at a cable station.

name: Seated Cable Row
description: Row the handle to your torso while keeping your back upright.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
description: Support yourself on a bench and row one dumbbell to the hip.

name: Barbell Back Squat
description: Squat with the barbell on your upper back until thighs are at least parallel.

name: Romanian Deadlift
description: Hinge at the hips with soft knees to stretch and work the hamstrings.

name: Leg Press
description: Push the sled away with your feet on the platform.

name: Walking Lunge
description: Step forward into a lunge holding dumbbells, alternating legs.

name: Lying Leg Curl
description: Curl the pad toward your glutes while lying face down.

name: Standing Calf Raise
description: Raise your heels as high as possible, then lower slowly.

name: Goblet Squat
description: Squat while holding a kettlebell close to your chest.

name: Overhead Press
description: Press the barbell from the front of your shoulders to overhead while standing.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
description: Raise dumbbells out to the sides up to shoulder height.

name: Face Pull
description: Pull a rope attachment toward your face with elbows high.

name: Barbell Curl
description: Curl the barbell up to your shoulders without swinging.

name: Hammer Curl
description: Curl dumbbells with a neutral (palms facing in) grip.

name: Tricep Pushdown
description: Push the cable bar down until your arms are fully extended.

name: Dips
description: Lower and press yourself up between parallel bars.

name: Plank
description: Hold a straight body position on your forearms and toes. Log seconds as reps.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
description: Hang from a bar and raise your legs to hip height or higher.

name: Kettlebell Swing
description: Swing the kettlebell to chest height by driving your hips forward.

name: Burpee
description: Drop to a push-up, jump the feet back in and jump up explosively.

name: Rowing Machine
description: Row on an ergometer. Log minutes or calories as reps.
